correctness.rationale: Proof explicitly maximizes the Chebyshev-reduced time-height contrast, then saturates Cauchy–Schwarz on the squared-amplitude circle. The negative-cosine domain is bounded by a polynomial with six positive exact Bernstein coefficients. Strict concavity on the remaining interval follows from an exact degree-seven positive-coefficient identity, giving a unique optimum above E=1/sqrt(97). Endpoints, local minimum at the reference crest and monotone peak separation are checked. Packaged check.py verifies every nonstandard symbolic identity and two rational examples; continuous results rest on the written proof.

value.rationale: Fixing a^2+b^2 is a physical aggregate variance constraint for two orthogonal tidal overtides. The result identifies a strict onset smaller than either overtide-only optimum, the one best allocation for every above-threshold energy and the exact increasing separation of two high tides. These directly refine double-high tidal-harmonic modeling, not merely renaming an elementary derivative check; they do not assert empirical attainability.
